items.content: <article>Schmitz, Johansen, et al. build a consensus cell type atlas of the mammalian spinal cord, integrating gene expression, chromatin accessibility, and spatial data across human, macaque, and mouse. Cell identity and laminar position are broadly conserved, while the dorsal horn emerges as the main site of neuronal expression divergence.</article>
